claim_boundary: Engineering refinement of existing incremental dependency tracking for a fixed bounded static resolver. Replay equality is neither Python semantic soundness nor coding-agent usefulness. No novelty, SOTA or maturity claim.
question: Do exact positive/negative module candidate tuples and namespace-existence answers reduce unnecessary graph reconstruction, and what is their full trajectory cost against a root-membership guard?

method_labels.incremental_read_set: A: legacy whole-catalog and source-read hashes
method_labels.incremental_catalog_coarse_guard: B: query-aware whole catalog, valid zero-query graphs exempt
method_labels.incremental_catalog_root_guard: C: complete membership of queried canonical module roots
method_labels.incremental_catalog_read_set: D: exact candidate tuples plus subtree-existence booleans

certificate: Process-local certificates only; every exact query including empty tuple, every exact-or-descendant existence query including false, all consulted source hashes including negative attribute checks, failed parsing and missing anchors; fixed anchors/policy. Invalid/missing/unsupported trace forces rebuild. Unknown/truncated output is preserved.

correctness_gate.failure_action: Preserve rows and counterexample; stop positive performance interpretation. Never remove fields, adjust tolerances or select away cases.

mechanism_gate: Frozen within-root unrelated add/remove counterexamples must reuse queried graphs without calling resolver; relevant query/source changes must rebuild. No-query controls alone do not establish granular-query value.

performance_target.metric: median sum of 16 replay updates, including source acquisition from local archive and all source integrity checks
performance_target.initial_capture: reported separately; total capture plus replay also reported

resource_gate.measurement: three fresh subprocesses per method/repository; median peaks and every sample retained

measurement.method_order: Rotate whole method trajectories by (repository index + repetition index), including warmup index -1; snapshots remain oldest to newest. No concurrent performance runs.
measurement.garbage_collection: normal interpreter defaults; no method-specific changes
include: read local archive bytes and SHA256
tar decompression and validated production file selection
decode declared Python source encoding and raw file hashing
initial anchor AST/exact source capture in initial capture
GraphSession input defensive copy, all-input hashes, module catalog/index work
source and catalog guards, necessary graph rebuilding
exclude: input metadata JSON parsing and protocol validation
fresh resolver and frozen-base oracle checks
measurement.cold_vs_warm: one unreported-time warmup trajectory per method; each timed trajectory uses a new session. Initial capture is warm-filesystem cold-session, not machine cold-start.

anchor_rule: At oldest primary snapshot enumerate unique direct module-body FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef path:symbol keys, sort by SHA256(UTF8(path+colon+symbol)), then identity, keep first24. Retain ambiguous/missing/unresolved anchors in later snapshots; never replace after outcomes.
secondary: All23 immediate parent-to-commit production catalog-change pairs in the same128 first-parent transition windows; mechanism diagnostics, no timing generalization or favorable-event selection. Independent session for each pair.
units: 4 convenience-sampled repositories, 64 eight-transition source batches. Anchors, repeated runs and event pairs are dependent observations, not independent studies.
sampling_limits: Repositories selected for structural feasibility and distinct software domains before candidate resolver/timing outcomes. AST source metadata was inspected; these are prospective natural trajectories, not strict untouched source holdouts or independent human validation. MCP Python SDK is also an optional integration dependency of this project; disclose relation.

negative_preflights.rule: fixed HEAD plus128 first-parent transitions and newest8catalog events

selection_amendment_before_freeze: Use the same live fixed HEAD windows,17equally-spaced snapshots as primary and all catalog events as secondary. This change is based only on source paths/resource/AST feasibility, not resolver reuse or performance. Earlier negative observations are retained.
legacy_fresh_equivalence: After freeze, independently reconstruct every unique source snapshot with the unmodified baseline ce6e36de resolver, compare canonical digests to new fresh reconstruction, retaining all mismatches. This guards shared catalog refactoring bugs; not a semantic oracle.
release_policy: Existing Draft PR only; no merge, new Release or mature-study label based on this run.
maturity_gaps: Broader independently selected repositories and platforms
Independent human semantic or evidence review
Novelty evidence beyond existing dependency tracking applications
